description: This PHP class, 'EmpEmergencyContactService', provides service methods for handling employee emergency contact data within the OrangeHRM system. It manages operations such as retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching emergency contact records, acting as an intermediary between the data access layer and other components.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactService
classes.description: Service class managing employee emergency contact data, providing methods for CRUD operations and searches, and interfacing with the DAO layer.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: setEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance for dependency injection or mocking purposes.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for an employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Fetches a list of emergency contacts for a specific employee.

methods.name: saveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee emergency contact record.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes specified emergency contact entries for an employee, or all if no specific entries are provided.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Searches for emergency contacts based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of emergency contacts matching the search filter.
